verdict.rationale: BigQuery's first-party docs describe conversational analytics for natural-language conversations with data. They also describe data agents configured with custom metadata, instructions, glossary terms and verified queries, which grounds answers semantically rather than leaving joins to the model. Gemini additionally supports natural-language finding, joining and querying of tables. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that NL answers enforce governance (e.g., IAM or row-level policies applied to agent queries), a documented semantic/metrics layer beyond glossary and verified queries, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of answer accuracy.
